reviews.summary: The 'say what reminded you' rule and the timing advice are usable at once, but one takeaway contradicted the body on when to send, and every line assumed a settled couple, leaving nothing for a new relationship.

dealbreakers: False claim about Ethos: 'all three are among our digital gifts for your boyfriend' (ES 'las tres están entre nuestros regalos digitales para tu novio'). /gifts/for-boyfriend lists ten ideas in src/content/recipients.ts (the-letter, on-repeat, jar-of-reasons, arcade, the-council, scratch-card, passport, pack-your-bags, front-page, constellations). Of the three, only The Letter is there. Neither paper-crane nor text-thread appears anywhere in recipients.ts.
reviews.summary: The product paragraph claimed Paper Crane and Text Thread are on /gifts/for-boyfriend, which lists only The Letter; the Text Thread note echoed other posts; one takeaway contradicted the body; 'cough drops' and 'On a hard week' were off; and the Spanish had a misread 'volver a casa contigo', 'con total seguridad' and 'también aquí estoy'.
The reason-first angle beats page one's greeting-card lists and the headings carry the search words, but the timing takeaway gave the opposite default to the body and FAQ.

applied: Product paragraph: all three templates tied to /occasions/just-because, where they appear; /gifts/for-boyfriend offered for more ideas (EN and ES).
Timing takeaway now matches the body: send when the thought happens, unless it's his busiest hour (EN and ES).
New section 'Thinking of you messages for him when it's still new' / «…cuando estáis empezando».
Text Thread note rewritten from the schema so it no longer echoes other posts.
'In a hard week'; romantic intro sentence fixed; 'toothpaste' for 'cough drops' (EN and ES).
Spanish: «al llegar a casa estés tú», «con un aplomo total», «también estoy aquí».
Link-in sentence in cute-things-to-say-to-your-boyfriend: 'The ones below' / «Los de abajo» so 'these' isn't ambiguous.

Polish taken: 'a safe default' for an unsourced 'most people'; a grief line ('I know what today is'); heading 'Short and funny thinking of you texts for him'; ES «La mayoría de los días», «por tercera vez hoy», «Que es en él en quien has pensado», FAQ sentence clarified.

reviews.summary: The timing takeaway now matches the body and the new-relationship section gives a reader a few weeks in lines she can send; it teaches her to write her own from whatever reminded her of him.
Every round-1 fix landed; the template notes and the just-because claim match the code, no sentence repeats another post, and the Spanish is natural Spain Spanish in her voice.
Covers every tone and situation page one does, adds the reason-first rule and timing nobody else gives, and stays clear of the boyfriend, good-morning and queued posts.

rejected: Final-round polish recorded, not applied: 'Thought of you' on the Saturday line (reader); a past-strength line in the hard-week list (search); «La media tarde», «al pie del cañón», «banco del parque», «la noche de allí», exact FAQ quote, varied endings in the new-relationship list and 'work pass' (editor).
